english_title: Proposition 1.2.7: Generalization of a Sufficient Condition for a Cauchy Sequence
statement_en: If a sequence $(a_n)$ in a metric space $(X,d)$ satisfies $d(a_{n+1},a_n)\leq b_n$ and the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} b_n$ converges, then $(a_n)$ is a Cauchy sequence in that metric space.
key_techniques: telescoping estimate in a metric space
tail control by a convergent series
callout_body: 如果度量空间$(X,d)$当中的序列$(a_n)$满足条件$d(a_{n+1},a_n)\leq b_n$并且$\sum_{n\geq 1}b_n$是一个收敛的级数，那么$a_n$是该度量空间当中的柯西列。
